package.description: Voice typing app with 12 AI speech models, including 5 fully local options.

en-US.description: Voice typing app with 12 AI speech models, including 5 fully local options.
en-US.longDescription: LazyTyper is an advanced voice typing app powered by 12 AI speech models, including DouBao Voice, ElevenLabs, Groq Whisper, Mistral, AssemblyAI, plus 5 offline local models that run entirely on the device. It records with a global hotkey, transcribes speech to text in real time, injects text at the cursor position, supports more than 100 languages, integrates with the system tray, and updates automatically.
en-US.name: LazyTyper

zh-CN.description: 支持 12 种 AI 语音模型（含 5 种本地模型）的语音输入工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: LazyTyper 是一款先进的语音输入工具，内置豆包语音、ElevenLabs、Groq Whisper、Mistral、AssemblyAI 等 12 种 AI 语音模型，其中 5 种本地模型可完全离线运行。支持全局快捷键录音、实时转写、光标处注入文本、100 多种语言、系统托盘集成与自动更新。
